Good to know

Your questions, answered.

Are these fixed packages?+

These collections are starting points for discussion. Your final proposal will specify the agreed decoration, services, materials and coordination scope.

What affects the quote?+

Venue size, installation requirements, event duration, floral choices, guest count and location can influence the scope and cost.

Can I combine ideas from different collections?+

Yes. Tell us which details you like so we can discuss a personal combination.

Are venue, catering and entertainment included?+

Do not assume these are included. Any third-party services and responsibilities should be explicitly discussed and listed in your quote.
